corpus_policy: These are the ten existing mandatory scenarios in ENGINE_2.0_CHECKLIST.md. Do not add mandatory fixtures unless new evidence demonstrates a material compatibility defect.

evidence_classes.I: Integrated replay through actual gameplay routines and the real game loop

staging_interventions: Set RandSeed to zero before loading the source world so the initial random sequence is reproducible.
Set TickSpeed to zero and use the staged SoundProbeSetSchedule(0,0,0) logical clock tape so six game cycles complete deterministically.
Queue six right-direction bytes before entering the original GamePlayLoop; preserve Pascal InputUpdate behavior, including its penultimate-byte buffer quirk.
Run the compiled DEMOINT executable in a fresh DOSBox-X session after its separate compile session to isolate compiler-inherited DOS allocation history.
Capture VideoWriteText cell writes and SoundQueue calls without replacing gameplay routines.

The staged editor key tape is enabled only during EditorLoop and disabled before gameplay; VideoWriteText and SoundQueue outputs are captured without replacing gameplay routines.

TimerTicks is fixed and the existing cycle-clock hook advances deterministic gameplay cycles; six normalized 8-key bytes exercise unpause and upward movement.

fixtures.scenario: malformed-file recovery and high-score insertion path
fixtures.test_fixture: tools/pascal-compat/F10IN.PAS; deterministic generated F10BAD.ZZT; missing F10ROOM.HI

interventions: The exact malformed fixture is 512 bytes with first word 0xFFFE; Pascal WorldLoad returns false and the production loader returns ZOO_ERROR_WRONGVER (-3).
The direct Pascal fixture supplies a missing F10ROOM.HI, seeds each 50-byte name payload with the same deterministic stale tail, and calls the original HighScoresLoad reset before gameplay.
RandSeed=0; GenerateTransitionTable runs before WorldCreate. World.Info.unk1 is seeded to zero before the malformed load and survives the failed-load/fallback-create path.
The direct Pascal program uses the same {$M 49152,163840,655360} directive as reconstructed ZZT.PAS, keeping the original high-score text-window routine within its intended stack budget.
The original GamePlayLoop executes two fixed-clock logical cycles and reaches the original HighScoresAdd death path. InputProbeSetReadKeys supplies KERRY and Enter to the existing name prompt.

The staged cell observer is disabled immediately before HighScoresAdd so modal high-score presentation writes are excluded from engine gameplay cell events; no gameplay routine or state transition is replaced.

The production fixture performs the malformed load/recovery, two real zoo_tick cycles, and the shared high-score reset/insert/save APIs. Scripted name input is supplied at the shared engine API boundary because the engine does not implement frontend name-entry UI.
Turbo Pascal compilation and execution use separate fresh DOSBox-X 2026.10.01 sessions; physical sound output is disabled while logical SoundQueue state remains captured.
